R1.description: Chat model menu: opening the runtime list re-reads it in the background; the list stays usable while it reads; a new model appears (AC-010)

R2.description: Chat model menu: a failed refresh keeps the last list, shows the error with Retry; Retry and "Refresh models" re-read (QR-001, AC-011)

R3.description: Concurrent opens share one server read (QR-002)

R4.description: Launch-config picker: opening refreshes, "Refresh models" is inside the list, a new model appears and a failure shows Retry (AC-010, AC-011)

R5.description: Narrow viewport (390x844): the chat model menu drill-in shows the refresh control and the list fits

R6.description: Launch panel: the SDK effort-only schema (no default) - what the Thinking control and the effort setting read before a choice
